title: Ala Singh Appeals to the Khalsa Against the Pathans

blocks.text: Ala Singh narrated his tale of woe before the Panth, describing how the Malerkotla Pathans and their allies were tormenting Malwa and hemming him in from fortified positions. His appeal is not only personal but regional, asking the Khalsa to intervene where scattered local power can no longer cope.

The response is strategic rather than impulsive. The Khalsa Panth did respond by agreeing to come after Diwali under Bhai Buddha Singh, provided Ala Singh prepares the ground and helps draw the enemy into open combat.
This page therefore sets the relief campaign in motion. Petition, promise, and timing are all fixed before the march begins.
